title: A Hollow for the Choir
author: L. M. Brightwater
blurb: Petra Whitlock, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, has spent twenty years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
